scripts.dev: export CLEAR_NEXT_CACHE=1; bunx prisma migrate deploy && node scripts/generate-prisma-clean.mjs && node scripts/assert-prisma-models.mjs && next dev
scripts.test:unit: DATABASE_URL="postgresql://mrms:mrms_dev_password@localhost:5434/mrms_scratch?schema=public" bunx prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL="postgresql://mrms:mrms_dev_password@localhost:5434/mrms_scratch?schema=public" node scripts/run-unit-tests.mjs
scripts.qa:data-integrity: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate && bun scripts/qa-data-integrity.mjs
scripts.qa:concurrency: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate && bun scripts/qa-concurrency.mjs
scripts.qa:repair-requests: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate && bun scripts/qa-repair-request-numbers.mjs
scripts.qa:all: bun run qa:data-integrity && bun run qa:concurrency && bun run qa:perf
scripts.pg:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres postgres-scratch
scripts.pg:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop postgres postgres-scratch
scripts.seed: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate && bun run prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:base: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate && bun run prisma/seed-base.ts
scripts.seed:demo: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate && bun run prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:commercial: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate && bun run prisma/seed-commercial.ts
scripts.dev:docker: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate && node scripts/assert-prisma-models.mjs && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000
scripts.dev:sh: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app bash
scripts.dev:psql: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec postgres psql -U mrms -d mrms
scripts.dev:test: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -e DATABASE_URL="postgresql://mrms:mrms_dev_password@postgres-scratch:5432/mrms_scratch?schema=public" app sh -c "bunx prisma migrate deploy && node scripts/run-unit-tests.mjs"
scripts.dev:check: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app sh -c "bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run lint"
scripts.dev:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app bun run seed
scripts.dev:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app bunx prisma migrate dev
